I'm looking at traces — multiple token-get requests are being rejected with org_quota_exceeded within the rate-limiter service. Matching request_ids in the customer's dump to our logs shows the calls are hitting an org id that used to belong to a sandbox project but appears to have been swapped into PulseCare's production org.

I pulled a snapshot of current project labels and quota assignments (attaching). No infra deployment changes in the last hour, but there was a background tiering job at 02:00 UTC that reconciles project aliases. The job processed ~1,200 alias mappings; I see one mapping that swapped project labels between two orgs (project-873 <-> project-978) during alias consolidation. That would explain why PulseCare's traffic is being capped by the wrong quota.

Immediate mitigation options I can push now:
- Temporarily increase the quota on the incorrectly assigned project to match PulseCare's expected capacity (fast, risk: brief over-commit).
- Roll the alias mapping change back and re-run reconciliation (safer but takes 10-20 min).
- Route PulseCare traffic to a fallback pool that has spare capacity (if policy allows).

Attaching: quota_mapping_snapshot_20270816.xlsx

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 10:02:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sudden 429s across our production tenants (urgent) — root cause & action

Root cause confirmed: automated alias reconciliation job incorrectly dereferenced two project aliases during a stale-merge, effectively swapping project_quota pointers. PulseCare's org_id is being checked against the sandbox project's quota bucket, leading to immediate 429s when their normal throughput resumes.

Action I'm initiating now (in order):
1) Pause the alias reconciliation job to prevent further swaps.
2) Temporarily set a quota override for the sandbox project to PulseCare's committed level (2x their average) so in-flight requests succeed while we fix mapping.
3) Backfill a mapping rollback change on the reconciliation job and test on a dry-run subset.
4) If overrides are not accepted by policy, SHIFT routing for pulsecare-org to fallback dedicated pool (will cause slight latency increase but avoids 429s).

Estimated times: pause & override: ~5 min; mapping rollback + dry-run + full reconcile: 15-25 min.

I'll push the override now and monitor. Will update in 5.

—Karthik
